title: Directed Reachability Lies in NL
statement: The language of encodings of finite directed graphs with a designated start and target vertex for which the target is reachable from the start belongs to $\mathrm{NL}$. Here $\mathrm{NL}$ consists of binary languages decidable by a finite nondeterministic Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $n$.
